scope: Only the separate QA package was installed. No Gradle run. Original app.superhealth retained version 2.6 code 26.
observations: Routine HLS playback rendered moving frames, with 40-second and 41-second media durations.
Fullscreen opened; it remained active when the routine advanced to the next exercise.
Pause froze both routine countdown (1:31) and media position (0:29), confirmed by consecutive UI snapshots.
Instructions appeared in fullscreen while playback was paused.
Forward 10 seconds changed media position from 0:29 to 0:39 without changing paused routine countdown.
HOME then reorder-to-front restored fullscreen, instructions, pause state, media position 0:39 and countdown 1:31.
Exit fullscreen returned to inline playback controls with the same paused position and countdown.
QA app left on Home at the end.
Filtered logcat for AndroidRuntime errors and StretchVideo warnings was empty after this test.
limitations: Physical rotation and TalkBack were not toggled during this smoke test.
This is a test of the installed APK hash, not a guarantee for APKs built later.
